en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Improves connection recovery, background reminders and device status. Please check the Dynamic Island and the optional symbol test under Privacy.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 改进设备状态、重连、后台提醒和诊断导出。请检查灵动岛显示；如仍然空白，可在「隐私保护」打开「灵动岛显示排查」对照锁屏效果。
